headline: Revenue grows but losses persist
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 638.9B, up about 26% y/y, while the operating loss was KRW 49.6B, 9.7% smaller than a year ago but wider than last quarter.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the preliminary results reports a net loss of KRW 128.5B. The operating loss widened by about KRW 35.2B from the prior quarter. Yahoo EPS was KRW -2,666 against KRW -2,277 last quarter. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary, unaudited results. EPS is Yahoo data.
